text.text_excerpt: I love this place. Why? Because I am on a tight budget and I am super cheap. I'm not afraid to admit it. I have 8 mouths to feed (and that includes my 2 furbabies). Yes, some of the items are damaged and outdated. But they gaurantee their items and allow you to return any item you find less than satisfactory. I have only recently started coming here on a more regular basis. The wine selection is super cheap! Like 3$ a bottle! Cheese and sandwich meats are what I usually look for. Produce prices can't be beat, although you don't always find the produce you're looking for. My kids like coming here bc there is a section where you can make $3 or$5 grab bags full of snacks from bins filled wit...

This the place i do most of my shopping. Screw what people say about expiration dates. Youll be surprised at the super cheap prices youll pay hear for the same exact overpriced studf youll find at other groceries. I love coming here because of all the weird, hard to find & unique items youll end up find here. Theres basically new stuff everyday you come. For you health nuts, theres tons of fresh organic items, and you can get a 6 pack of craft beer for 3.99! Theres also a whole long wall of wine! This place is huge. Once you shop here you wont want to waste your money anywheres else. The staff & cashiers are very helpful and always greet you with a nice conversation. Come check this place...

This store is not like our everyday ordinary store. It's a Savage Store which means some of the cans are dented, not everything is in it's place and priced below our normal. Some of the items come in bundles. What a deal! And on Fridays there's a parking lot sale. Check this place out guys!
